q: Which of the following international organisations did Denmark become a member of in 1973?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2021 exam.

da.q: Hvilken af følgende internationale organisationer blev Danmark medlem af i 1973?

learn.text: But the decisions of these international organisations also help set the framework for Danish society. International, and especially European, cooperation therefore has great importance for Denmark.

q: What is the Nordic organisation that handles cooperation between the Nordic countries' parliaments called?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2022, May 2025 and June 2026 exams.

da.q: Hvad hedder den nordiske organisation, der varetager samarbejdet mellem de nordiske landes parlamenter?

learn.text: The exams also ask this: the Nordic Council, Nordisk Råd, is the organisation for cooperation between the parliaments of the Nordic countries, and the Nordic Council of Ministers is the cooperation between the governments.
